launch_slurm_job: launch a Slurm job by generating an sbatch script and submitting it via sbatch or bash launcher
copy_python_yaml_files: copy Python and YAML files from an input directory to an output directory using rsync
retrieve_partition_max_time: retrieve the maximum time limit in minutes for each Slurm partition using sinfo
validate_stool_args: validate StoolArgs by setting default time limits, conda path, and checking required fields
run_stool_cli: run the stool CLI module to submit a training job to a Slurm cluster with a config file
